require "fpm/package"
require "backports/latest"

# Empty Package type. For strict/meta/virtual package creation

class FPM::Package::Empty < FPM::Package
  def output(output_path)
    logger.warn("Your package has gone into the void.")
  end
  def to_s(fmt)
    return ""
  end

  def validate_command(validator)
    command = validator.instance_variable_get(:@command)
    messages = validator.messages

    logger.debug("Validating fpm command",
                 :input_type => command.input_type,
                 :output_type => command.output_type,
                 :architecture => architecture,
                 :level => logger.level,
                 :tar_name_issue => FPM::Issues::TarWriter.has_issues_with_split_name?,
                 :tar_symlink_issue => FPM::Issues::TarWriter.has_issues_with_add_symlink?)

    # Make sure the user has passed '-s' and '-t' flags
    if command.input_type.nil? or !command.input_type
      messages << "Missing required -s flag. What package source did you want?"
      validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
    end
    if command.output_type.nil? or !command.output_type
      messages << "Missing required -t flag. What package output did you want?"
      validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
    end

    # Verify the types requested are valid
    types = FPM::Package.types.keys.sort
    command.input_type.tap do |val|
      next if val.nil?
      if !FPM::Package.types.include?(val)
        messages << "Invalid input package -s flag) type #{val.inspect}. " \
                    "Expected one of: #{types.join(", ")}"
        validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
      end
    end

    command.output_type.tap do |val|
      next if val.nil?
      if !FPM::Package.types.include?(val)
        messages << "Invalid output package (-t flag) type #{val.inspect}. " \
                    "Expected one of: #{types.join(", ")}"
        validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
      end
    end

    command.dependencies.tap do |dependencies|
      # Verify dependencies don't include commas (#257)
      dependencies.each do |dep|
        next unless dep.include?(",")
        splitdeps = dep.split(/\s*,\s*/)
        messages << "Dependencies should not " \
          "include commas. If you want to specify multiple dependencies, use " \
          "the '-d' flag multiple times. Example: " + \
          splitdeps.map { |d| "-d '#{d}'" }.join(" ")
      end
    end

    if command.inputs
      if command.input_type != "dir"
        messages << "--inputs is only valid with -s dir"
        validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
      end
    end

    if !(command.args.any? || command.inputs || command.input_type == 'empty')
      messages << "No parameters given. You need to pass additional command " \
                    "arguments so that I know what you want to build packages " \
                    "from. For example, for '-s dir' you would pass a list of " \
                    "files and directories. For '-s gem' you would pass a one" \
                    " or more gems to package from. As a full example, this " \
                    "will make an rpm of the 'json' rubygem: " \
                    "`fpm -s gem -t rpm json`"
      validator.instance_variable_set(:@valid, false)
    end
  end # def validate_command
end

require "spec_setup"
require "fpm" # local

describe FPM::Package::Empty do
  describe "#to_s" do
    before do
      subject.name = "name"
      subject.version = "123"
      subject.architecture = "all"
      subject.iteration = "100"
      subject.epoch = "5"
    end
    it "should always return the empty string" do
      expect(subject.to_s "NAME-VERSION-ITERATION.ARCH.TYPE").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "gobbledegook").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s nil).to(be == "")
    end
  end # describe to_s

  describe "#architecture" do
    it "should default to 'all'" do
      insist { subject.architecture } == "all"
    end

    it "should accept changing the architecture" do
      subject.architecture = "native"
      insist { subject.architecture } == "native"
    end
  end
end # describe FPM::Package::Empty
